query: What drives praise and complaints in Amazon reviews?

per_column.name: performance_vs_claim
per_column.rationale: Whether the product performs relative to its stated claims is a genuine constitutive aspect of what people praise or complain about -- an 'aspect of' the driver space.

per_column.name: content_quality_aspect
per_column.rationale: Intrinsic quality dimensions (plot, writing, production, accuracy, pacing) are a core substantive facet of what drives praise/complaints for review content.

per_column.name: value_expectation_outcome
per_column.rationale: Value-for-money / expectation outcome is a distinct constitutive driver of satisfaction, an aspect of the driver concept.

per_column.name: recommendation_stance
per_column.rationale: Whether the reviewer recommends or warns is an OUTCOME/expression of the overall praise-vs-complaint judgment, not a constitutive driver of it. It restates the summary valence rather than decomposing its causes.

per_column.name: emotional_intensity
per_column.rationale: Intensity of emotion is a property of the overall sentiment/reaction, not a driver aspect. It measures strength of the whole reaction rather than a part-of the driver space.

judge.rationale: Three columns (performance_vs_claim, content_quality_aspect, value_expectation_outcome) are true meronymic facets that carve driver space into distinct aspects: claim-performance fit, intrinsic quality, and value/expectation. However performance_vs_claim and value_expectation_outcome partially overlap since 'meets/below expectation' and 'meets/below claim' capture closely related fulfillment aspects, lowering mutual exclusivity. recommendation_stance and emotional_intensity are not facets -- they are downstream expressions/properties of the overall verdict (restatements of valence and its strength), not constitutive drivers. Coverage of driver aspects is moderate: quality, claim-fit, and value are captured, but other common drivers (delivery/shipping, packaging, seller/customer service, durability/reliability, usability) are absent, capping exhaustiveness.
